content: Jesus Axaha Tyoma Maheta Waiyexe Maomakahare

Hatyaoseta haiyaharenai fariseunai, saduceunai xoaha xaneha Jesus kakoa iraeha maheta, kasani hasakaharetyahene aokowiyahitaha hoka xoalini hare nomaka aokaha ihiye hoka waiyaha maheta, xoana aliterexe xamani Enore nalita tyoita iniyatere, maisa xamani.
Hoka Jesus nehena: — Makehena atyo xihiye hoka xita: “Waiye akaite wihiye, hiyaiya, enokoa xotyakoa”, xita.

Nikare weta hoka xita: “One ite wihiye, hiyaiya, xotya aka exahe makalikoa xoaha”, xita. Xawahakohena atyo enokoa hoka waiyekehalakita atyo xomana hatyoharenae. Xakore hoka maisa atyo waiyekehalakere xomana kalikini kaotyakitereharenai.

Kalikiniyerenai atyo maisa waiyexe, maisa tyakekohatiyeha! Xoalini hare nomaka atyo aokaha nohiye tyakekoha maheta. Xakore hoka Jonas tyaohenere akere taitaite kaomaka enomanaha tyakekoha maheta — nexa ihiyeha. Hatyaoseta kikisoaheta enonyahita hoka xaneheta.
Fariseunai, Saduceunai Xoaha Xaotyakiraho
Xanehenaha halakoiya maniya hoka exaotyakiraharenai maotyaneha nakairati hakolalaha.
Hoka Jesus nehena: — Xasemehena, xirihalira fariseunai, saduceunai xoaha kaorehityakala kakoa — nexa.
— Kala nakairati wimakolarehenere hiyeta nikareta — nexa exaotyakiraharenai hatyo kakoaha iraikakoahenaha.
Jesus sema iniraikakoaneha hoka nehena: — Xoana hoka xiraikakoita nakairati ximakolarehenere hiyeta? Xoana hoka inira xityakekone tyaonita?
Xoana maisa waiyekehalakere xomana? Xoana maisa xotyare 5-tohase nakairati nirahenere 5.000-hare halitinai ana? Exowaka, xoanamate kohokiji xekaiseheta?
Xoana maisa xotyare sete tohase nakairati nirahenere 4.000-hare halitinai ana? Exowaka, xoanamate kohokiji xekaiseheta?
—“Maika xirihare fariseunai, saduceunai xoaha kaorehityakala kakoa”, nomi xakore hoka maisa atyo nakairati tahi xini niraeta. Xoana maisa waiyekehalakere xomana? nexa.
Hoka hatyaoseta exaotyakiraharenai ana iniraene waiyekehalaka. Maisa nakairati kaorehityakala kakoa kaxaikoawiha maheta xini hoka fariseunai, exahe saduceunai xaotyakira kakoa irihareha maheta.
Pedro Irae Jesus Hiye
Hatyaoseta Jesus xane wenakalati Cesaréia de Filipe maniya. Hatyo nali axehena haxaotyakiraharenai: — Xala halitinai aokita natyo Haliti Ityani? nexa.

— Haiyanai atyo João Batista aokahitaha hiso. Haiyanai tehitiya atyo Elias aokahitaha hiso. Nikare haiyanai Jeremias aokahitaha hiso. Haiyanai tehitiya iraiti xakaisasehare aokahitaha hiso — nexaha ihiye.
— Hoka xiso atyo xala xaokita natyo? nexa Jesus ihiyeha.
Simão Pedro nehena ihiye: — Hiso atyo Enore Kalorexe Aohenere. Hiso atyo Enore Ityani — nexa.
— Waiye kaiserehare nikare hiraeta, Simão, João ityani — nexa Jesus. — Maisa haliti xini awaiyekehalakatene homana. Baba enokoa tyaonitere atyo awaiyekehalakatene homana — nexa Jesus Pedro hiye.
— Hiyeta hoka nomita hihiye: hiso atyo Pedro hoka exe sehali henoite notyoma nohani. (Tyotya ekoa maniya tyaoniterenai xaokaka, “Nohani”, nita). Maisaiya efaharenai kinatere tyaonita exahitaha.

Nisaite homana enokoa majiholatyakala. Hoka xoare xamani atyoite hamahokoanetya ali waikohekoa hoka enokoa nali atyoite kamahokoanetyaka tehitiya. Hoka xoare xamani atyoite haoka ali waikohekoa hoka kaxaokaka tehitiya atyoite enokoa nali — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai hiye hatyohare maxakaisakene haiyanai hiye aoka.
Jesus Irae Hakamane, Hakaseneheta Tahi

Hatyaoseta Jesus iraehena mametaharenehare haxaotyakiraharenai hiye: — Jerusalém terota noxani hoka hatyo nalite judeunai nityohalitiranai, saduceunai xekohaseharenai, xaotyakiyaho kakoa waiyoreterenai harenaite iniyalahare axomokakihena natyo kalore. Nokaxaisakite hoka hanamaki ferakene najikinitaite nokaseheta — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Pedro nolokene haware hoka nehena ihiye: — Maisaiya nikareta xini. Maisaiya nikare hikaxomokakita, Xekohaseti — nexa.

Hoka Jesus ehaikoahareheta hoka nexa Pedro hiye: — Hakikisoahetehena nahitita, Ahalakoahaliti! Hiso atyo sehali kajiyakoatyakitere akereta nahotiri hisaonita. Hiyaiya, haliti xahekola akereta atyo hahekoita, maisa atyo Enore ahekoitere akereta xini — nexa.

Hatyaoseta Jesus nexa haxaotyakiraharenai hiye: — Xala xamani atyo tyaona nokoamaniye aokowihena hoka maika hatyota maotyanoawi hoka maika kolatya haberekotyaka niyahare atyalihose xaimaholatyaka hoka tyaona noximi.
Hiyaiya, xala xamani atyoite wenati waiyexe tawita hoka meta atyoite enonita. Xakore hoka xala xamani atyoite nohiyiti kaxaisaka hoka kaiyakeheta atyoite hoka wenati waiyexe nali hikoa.
Hoka xoare mahetaiya hatya haliti hakakoare waikohekoa xiyehaliti harenai kakoa tyaona hoka hatyaoseta waini? Maisaiya xoare hare bakatya hoka ekasekihititene.
Hiyaiya, Haliti Ityanite tyoheta Hanexe werokene kakoa, anjo haomanerenai kakoa hoka sema halitinai tahi hoka enómanenaiha akereta mohenahene.
— Exeharíra xotyaxematya: ali haiyaharenai tyaonitereharenaite maisa wainahitaha hamawaiyaneneharahita Haliti Ityani tyohetehenere xowaka nahitita — nexa.
